conviction_note: Two forces of similar size pull opposite ways. Africa's Q3 smartphone collapse (Omdia -39% YoY, Transsion revenue -27%) threatens the low end of the 15-25% Q3 GMV guide and the FY 20-30% GMV range. Against that, the stock goes in at a 52-week low, 11% below the August placement price and 58% below the mean target, with an EBITDA path that the mix shift away from phones helps. The findings sum to +1.3. p_up 52 on abs 15.5 gives +0.62, close to zero because the GMV risk and the low bar are of similar size.

next_guide.basis: Profitability guide likely maintained: the CEO said on 2026-08-14 that softer hardware 'does not prevent us from reaching profitability' and that breakeven needs no extra cash, the mix away from low-margin phones helps take rate, and $50M of new equity funds Q4 working capital. The FY GMV range is the line at risk of a cut to the low end or below, because Africa smartphone shipments fell 39% in Q3 (Omdia, 2026-10-29) against -7% in Q2, when the guide was set.

findings.finding: Africa smartphone shipments fell 39% YoY in Q3 2026, the steepest of any region (Omdia, 2026-10-29), against -7% in Q2 2026, when Jumia set its Q3 GMV guide of +15-25% and cut FY GMV to +20-30%. Phones are 10-20% of Jumia GMV and other electronics a bit over 20% (management, Q2 call). The steeper Q3 slump puts the low end of the Q3 guide and the FY range at risk. Net of the rest: Q2 GMV still grew 23% with phones already disrupted, because fashion, home and accessories grew. Higher ASPs (+$41 to $202) cushion the value decline relative to the unit decline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: GMV/guide line: Q2 2026 GMV guide cut (27-32% -> 20-30%) was bought +10% because the EBITDA narrowing and IFC raise dominated; Q4 2025 -15.8% when the profitability timeline was not pulled forward. The stock has not been punished for GMV alone when profitability held.
findings.why_not_priced: Jumia gave no update after 2026-08-12 and no sell-side note tying the Omdia Africa figure to Jumia was found. Part of it is probably in the -15% 20-day slide, but the skew is balanced (-0.84) and put/call OI is 0.29, so options do not show a priced GMV miss. Had the market priced a guide cut, puts would carry a premium.

findings.finding: Transsion (Tecno/Infinix, ~47% of Africa smartphone share in Q2) reported Q3 2026 revenue -27.45% YoY to CNY 14.85bn on 2026-10-30, citing higher supply-chain (memory) costs and 'reduced market capacity'. Inventory rose 82% YoY to ~139 days of cover. This is the dominant phone supplier in Jumia's markets confirming the Q3 volume slump.
findings.link: Transsion brands are the main entry-level phones sold in Jumia's Nigeria/Kenya/Egypt/Ivory Coast markets. Phones are 10-20% of Jumia GMV. Transsion shipments -14% and share 51% -> 47% in Africa Q2 2026 (Omdia).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior Jumia print reacted visibly to a Transsion print; the Q2 phone disruption was absorbed (+10% on the day).
findings.why_not_priced: Transsion reports in China/HK and no Jumia coverage cited it. The 139-day inventory build is a two-sided fact: it could mean discounted phone supply for Jumia's Q4 Black Friday. That cuts the net sign for the guide, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: Shares its theme with the Omdia finding (both measure the Q3 African phone slump). It is a separate company-level primary report, not the same document. Sized small so the theme is not counted twice.

findings.finding: The naira strengthened to N1,333/$ on 2026-10-14 against ~N1,478-1,495/$ in September 2025, roughly a 10%+ USD tailwind on Nigeria, Jumia's largest GMV market. In Q2 the company's own numbers showed the transmission: reported GMV +20% against constant currency +15%. Most of this was visible when the Q3 guide was set in August, so it lands largely inside the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FX has been a reported-vs-cc footnote. No print turned on it in 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: Most of it is priced, because the August guide was set with the naira already firm. The residual is any further strengthening in Aug-Sep. Had the market priced the full tailwind, the revenue consensus would not sit as low as $46.5M on one aggregator.

findings.finding: The FY2026 adj. EBITDA guide of -$25M to -$30M, with H1 at -$19.4M, implies H2 at -$5.6M to -$10.6M. If Q4 is at breakeven, Q3 is implied at -$5.6M to -$10.6M, against -$8.7M in Q2 and -$14.0M in Q3 2025. Management said on the Q2 call that losing phone volume has a positive mix effect on margins, because home, fashion and accessories carry higher take rates. That favours a Q3 loss at or inside the implied range.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: EBITDA/loss line has carried the reaction: Q4 2025 EPS miss -15.8%; Q2 2026 EBITDA loss -36% YoY with the stock +10%.
findings.why_not_priced: The implied Q3 range comes from the company's own arithmetic and lands inside guidance, so it is mostly expected. The unpriced part is the mix tailwind from the deeper phone slump, which the market treats only as a GMV negative (stock -15% in 20 days).

findings.finding: The Q4 2026 adj. EBITDA breakeven and positive cash flow target is likely to be reaffirmed. The CEO said on 2026-08-14 that softer hardware 'does not prevent us from reaching profitability' and that breakeven needs no additional cash. The $50M placement was earmarked to pre-fund Q4 vendor supply. No walk-back appeared in any statement after the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The breakeven timeline is the line this stock trades on: unchanged timeline -15.8% (Feb 2026), reaffirmed with accelerating growth +16.8% (May 2026), reaffirmed with GMV cut +10% (Aug 2026).

If the market believed the reaffirmation, the stock would not trade at a 52-week low with the target cut to $9. A reaffirmation therefore clears a lower bar than consensus targets imply.

findings.finding: Temu stepped up in Nigeria during Q3. Temu's Google search interest passed Jumia's for the first time in a spike from 2026-07-08 (company-cited, 2026-08-18). Temu then approved Kwikpik as a last-mile courier from local fulfilment centres in early September 2026. This is competitive pressure in Jumia's largest market during the quarter being reported.
findings.link: Direct competitor for the same Nigerian online shoppers. Nigeria is Jumia's largest GMV market (Nigeria GMV +42% in Q1 2026). No revenue overlap figure is available.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Temu's late-2024 Nigeria launch coincided with weak 2025 order trends; Jumia's Nigeria GMV nonetheless grew 42% in Q1 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: Search-interest and logistics moves are not in any consensus. It is a proxy, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: Nigeria headline inflation fell to 14.63% in September 2026 from 15.39% in August, the fourth straight monthly decline. Coronation forecast ~13.6% for October. Real purchasing power in Jumia's largest market is improving into Q4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Management tied Nigeria growth to macro reforms in June 2026. No print reacted to inflation data.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a macro-to-company link that the company has not confirmed, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: Liquidity will show the ~$50M placement (closing expected in the second half of August) against $48.3M at June 30. The company said it would build working capital further in Q3 to secure Q4 supply, so Q3 operating cash outflow may exceed Q2's $11.8M. The money buys inventory and vendor pre-funding for the Q4 peak, which is a stated, corroborated use.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Liquidity decline of $14.3M in Q2 did not prevent a +10% reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Guided by the company, so this lands inside expectations. Filed so a larger Q3 burn is not misread as a negative surprise.

outside_window.finding: Whether Q4 2026 adj. EBITDA breakeven and positive cash flow are actually delivered resolves with Q4 results in about February 2027. Only the reaffirmation is inside this window.
Transsion's ~139 days of inventory could lead to discounting and better entry-level phone supply for Jumia's Black Friday (to 2026-11-30). That would show in Q4 GMV.
